visualInspection.formatDecision: The documented 4:3 exception is justified for this three-cell vertical composition: at 360 px width it provides 270 px of height, keeping the outcome cell and model label larger than a 16:9 layout would. The fixed-width displays use contain rather than crop.

findings.detail: The arithmetic and the drawing agree: a possible gamete with two chromosome 21 copies plus a one-copy gamete yields a cell with three separate chromosome 21 copies. This represents the extra whole chromosome of free trisomy 21, not a translocation fragment or a single-gene change. Colors are counting aids; each rod has the same chromosome-21 shape.

The image shows a possible two-copy gamete and subsequent 2 + 1 outcome. It does not depict the preceding nondisjunction, both meiotic divisions, the rest of the chromosome set or a diagnostic karyogram. The large 'vereinfachtes Modell' label makes the simplification visible. Pair it with truthful text or alt text explaining that a chromosome-separation error can produce the two-copy gamete; never describe the image itself as a complete meiosis or a diagnosis.

There are no people, phenotype cues, health judgments, pathologizing words or diagnostic claims. The warm opaque cream background, soft cell colors, hand-drawn outlines and clear shapes fit a friendly comic-like classroom illustration rather than photorealism or sterile technical drafting.

V1 is preserved. Its transparent background left navy text vulnerable to dark surfaces and its bottom model label was small at 360 px. V2 uses an opaque background and larger title and model label; both observed defects are resolved without changing the 2 + 1 chromosome count.

requiredIntegrationCaptionOrAltText: Vereinfachtes Modell nur für Chromosom 21: Nach einer möglichen Fehlverteilung enthält eine Keimzelle zwei einzelne Chromosomen 21, die andere eines. Nach ihrer Vereinigung liegen drei getrennte Chromosomen 21 vor. Weitere Chromosomen und die Meioseschritte sind nicht dargestellt; die Farben dienen nur der Unterscheidung.
sourceScope: Official HE E.3 calls for the mutation principle using trisomy 21 as example. NIH MedlinePlus Genetics supports a reproductive-cell nondisjunction route to an extra chromosome 21 and distinguishes translocation and mosaic forms. The picture illustrates only the free-trisomy chromosome-number route named in the current canonical goal.
